## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmed by shallow sector breadth (only Energy, Healthcare, Consumer Staples positive) and mixed leadership (strong Energy/Staples while Tech shows split performance). Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 4 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND.  
Healthcare leads modestly: UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND.  
Consumer Staples showing strength: PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.07%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier.  
Technology showing intra-sector weakness: SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND; PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND; F (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.07%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented), favor cyclical/energy exposure within a neutral stance.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: AMD (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%) CORRECTION; EL (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +6.56%) CORRECTION; BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND; BA (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION; QCOM (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +49.84%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in high-beta Tech and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W: CSCO (1W: +22.41%), PANW (1W: +16.81%), OXY (1W: +12.43%), PM (1W: +10.89%), XOM (1W: +9.98%) — watch for follow-through. Market shows MAJOR divergence (multiple large-cap names with 1W down vs 1M up such as INTC, QCOM, AMD); suppress one-sided regime bets and watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is mixed/CORRECTION in places: AAPL (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) ABOVE TREND but INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) CORRECTION and SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND — breadth: Tech 24 stocks, 1W weakness overall.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are mixed to soft: JPM (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.92%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: -0.26% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W flattening and lacks broad leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare shows resilience: UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -3.34%) RECOVERY; watch PFE (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND despite positive headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and select Consumer Staples exposure given clear 1W strength (XOM, OXY, PM showing strength) and reduce exposure to structurally weak Tech names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (SHOP, INTC, BKNG). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective and size for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) CORRECTION, BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND — watch news/earnings flow for follow-through.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +5.82%) — strong short-term momentum.  
BEARISH: Utilities and Consumer Discretionary (Utilities 1W: -2.63% | Consumer Disc. 1W: -2.48%) — watch continued outflows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch XOM hold of this week’s breakout (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) to confirm Energy continuation; NVDA (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) must sustain weekly gains to remain ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) needs reclaim of recent weekly losses to avoid deeper CORRECTION; PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) sustaining above-weekly range would extend Staples leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PM (+55): Philip Morris (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price strength.  
PFE (+75): Pfizer (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND — positive FDA news but price is diverging (distribution risk).  
CEG (+80): Constellation Energy (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND — strong bullish headlines but price falling, clear divergence.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BKNG (-55): Booking Holdings (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND — negative guidance confirmed by price.  
AMD (-50): AMD (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%) CORRECTION — analyst downgrades vs strong 1M gains shows tactical pullback.  
BA (-45): Boeing (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION — negative commentary tracking with weekly weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: very shallow breadth (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive) and notable price/news divergences in CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND — monitor for confirmation before scaling exposure.
